prompt: Ablation baseline run: lay out as-twn-kaohsiung-shape-rect's skeleton-map points on a grid from scratch, reasoning point-by-point (no auto-placement algorithm). Beat the ranked-snap baseline on hv while keeping edge winding order intact and orderFlip/meanDrift low.

transcript.note: Round 1: worked out the 3 lines by hand from segs/nbr — Red (1-9-5-3-8-7-2, N to S), Orange (4-8-16-10-12, W to E), and the Circular LRT loop (4-11-6-7-14-16-0-3-15-13-4). Placed the 5 winding-order-checked vertices (3,4,7,8,16) using their real atan2 bearings reduced to cardinal directions, verified the required cyclic neighbour order held at each. Then built two vertical spines that fall out of that: col0={4,13,15} (the loop's NW arc) and col9={6,7,14,16,0} (loop's E arc + crossing), plus col5={11,1,6,8,5,3} (the tight west-central cluster gx157-244) merged only where the real gx gap was small (<20-50) so no clear order pairs got reversed. Row ties used the same rule (merge only tight gy clusters, e.g. {3,15,0} gy596-626, {8,16,10,12,4} gy707-749). Kept node 9 in the col9 group (gx398) rather than tying it to the Red-line-south cluster (gx208-244), since that gap is ~150 and would have reversed 9 vs 7/16/0/14. Straight so far: 4-8, 11-6, 4-13, 13-15, 15-3, 8-16, 8-3, 16-10, 10-12, 16-0, 0-3, 16-14, 14-7, 5-3 (14/20). Not straight: 4-11, 6-7, 8-7, 1-9, 9-5, 7-2 (the long diagonal arcs and the remote termini 1/2/9/12 which sit far from their neighbours' clusters).
